mechanism: Both drugs cause CNS depression and have additive effects on sedation and hypotension through their respective mechanisms (carisoprodol as a muscle relaxant metabolized to meprobamate, guanfacine as an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist).
action: Monitor patients for excessive sedation, dizziness, and hypotension; consider dose reduction or alternative therapy if significant CNS depression or hemodynamic instability occurs.
